title: Paloma Business Service Entitlements by Plan
content:
Each Paloma Business plan sets three service entitlements: whether a named account manager serves the business, the Paloma business days within which a requested callback must take place, and the months of balance and payout history available on statements.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Named account manager | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Callback within (Paloma business days) | 3 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Statement history available (months) | 12 | 24 | 36 | 60 | 84 | 84 |

### Points of reference

- A named account manager serves only the Paloma Business Scale and Paloma Business Enterprise plans.
- The longest statement history, 84 months, is shared by Scale and Enterprise; Paloma Business Starter offers 12 months.
- A callback requested on Paloma Business Pro must take place within 1 Paloma business day.
